# pve_storage_scan_iscsi (Data Source)

iSCSI targets discovered by scanning from a node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_storage_scan_iscsi" "example" {
node = "pve1"
portal = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `portal` (String) The iSCSI portal (IP or DNS name with optional port).

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/scan/iscsi. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>.

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `portal` (String) The iSCSI portal name.
- `target` (String) The iSCSI target name.
